faq.a: Masudi is associated with the Arabic form مسعودي, whose core sense is masudi; of masud, belonging to masud.

faq.q: What is the origin of Masudi?
faq.a: Masudi is associated with Arabic. Masudi is Arabic مَسْعُودِي (Masʿūdī), the nisba ('of Masud, belonging to Masud') of مَسْعُود (Masʿūd). The source gloss 'Wise, Knowledgeable' is unsupported and has been replaced with the relational sense.
Yes — the underlying form مسعودي is Arabic.
Masudi can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Masudi should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. False

faq.q: What does Masudi mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Masudi is rendered مسعودی and carries the sense مسعودی، مسعود سے منسوب.

faq.q: What does Masudi mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Masudi is rendered مسعودی and carries the sense مسعودی، منسوب به مسعود.
A romanized syllable approximation is ma-su-di. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Masudi?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Masudi, masudi. Script forms are مسعودي, مسعودی, मसूदी.

faq.q: Is Masudi a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
